name: Acid
text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a vial of Acid.

name: Alchemist's Fire
text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Alchemist's Fire.

name: Antitoxin
text: As a Bonus Action, you can drink a vial of Antitoxin to gain Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.

name: Holy Water
text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Holy Water.

name: Oil
text: You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

name: Basic Poison
text: As a Bonus Action, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition.

name: Rations
text: Rations consist of travel ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

name: Spellbook
text: A leather-bound book with 100 blank vellum pages, used by wizards to record the spells they know.

name: Artisan's Tools
text: One set of artisan's tools of your choice (for example Carpenter's, Smith's or Weaver's Tools). Rename it to the kind you picked.

name: Arrows
text: Ammunition for a Longbow or Shortbow. A quiver holds 20.

name: Crossbow Bolts
text: Ammunition for a crossbow. A bolt case holds 20.

name: Sling Bullets
text: Ammunition for a Sling. A pouch holds 20.

name: Blowgun Needles
text: Ammunition for a Blowgun. A pouch holds 50.

name: Firearm Bullets
text: Ammunition for a Musket or Pistol. A pouch holds 10.
